The maintenance procedures should be done on 
 the twin fine filter when the pressure drop across the filter is about 0.4 
 bars.

The design of the twin oil filter is shown 
 in figure 1 .the filter size is selected, so that the pressure loss with 
 clean strainer coat 56 amounts to 0.15-0.25 bar depending on the oil 
 temperature. The by-pass valve 12, 22 is set for maximum pressure drop of 
 about 0.4bar. If this is exceeded. The filter is by-pass this bypass 
 operation is shown by indicator see the figure. Filtration must now be 
 immediately switched to the stands by filter. An indicator 44, 45, 46 on the 
 lower part on the warm gear casing 3 announces which filter is operative.

The pipe from the filter to the bearing is 
 kept as short as possible. To permit its mechanical cleaning during 
 erection. This eliminates the danger of recontamination the already purified 
 oil.

 initiated by eng. Magdi Sami Ebrahim, tested by eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Ahmed 
 and eng. Magdi Sami Ebrahim, and approved by eng. Mohamed Salah Eldin Abd 
 Elghafar general director.

This document 
 revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and 
 certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's 
 Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

A 
work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.

A 
work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.
Wrench 14-15,
Screwdriver, Hammer,
Allan Key 10.
Air compressor.
Cleaning Fluid.
Rope

Loosen the star knob screws 68,.69 on the 
 filter cover 52 of the dirty set.

Remove the screws, the filter cover and the 
 gasket 71.

Open the drain cock and drain the filter 
 casing 51 into the drain pipe connected at C.

Loosen the screws 67 of the filter support 
 53 by means of the socket wrench 70 attached to the star knob screw.

Lift off the filter support 53 by its welded ring 
 bolt and let it drip.

Unscrew the clamps 60, above and below & 
 carefully remove the strainer coat 56 and strainer coat protection 72 form the 
 filter cylinder 57.

Check it for defects. if there are imperfections, 
 replace them by new ones.

The cleaned or new coat is pulled back over the 
 filter cylinder 57 clamped, and the whole unit is dropped into cleaned filter 
 casing 51.

The arrow on the filter points towards the oil 
 outlet D and the centering in of the filter support 53 engages the support 
 ring the filter support and spacer tube 66 are tightened with bolts 67.

Mount the filter support cover 52 with its 
 cleaned and lightly oiled gasket 71 upon the filter casing 51 and tighten 
 the star knob screws 68, 69 firmly and evenly close the drainers at C & D.

Prior to the expiration of their 
 life expectancy of 1 year, the strainer coat 56 may be washed in any one of 
 the following solvents:

White spirits with flash point 39
 ْC.
Kerosene (solvent naphta).
Burning oil.

Normal gasoline (not recommended, since it is 
 highly flammable).

Perchlorethylene (not recommended, since it is 
 highly noxious).

After rinsing, gently squeeze out the strainer 
 coats 56, but do not wring them out.
Re-insert them after drying as described above.
